title: Circuit Breaker Pattern

searches.query: "Circuit Breaker Pattern" interview half open production
searches.result: success; exact-concept search executed, but independent frequency/rank/company evidence was insufficient; prompts are original production adaptations and technical decisions use checked primary sources

sources.title: Microsoft Azure: Circuit Breaker pattern
sources.supportRationale: Failure-aware admission and staged recovery as distinct from repeated attempts.

sources.title: Resilience4j: CircuitBreaker guide
sources.supportRationale: Documented rolling-window and half-open behavior; a breaker does not itself limit concurrency. Descriptive guide checked, no unpinned Java API code supplied.

sources.title: Microsoft Azure: Bulkhead pattern
sources.supportRationale: Resource partitioning to contain dependency/consumer failure propagation.

sources.title: Google SRE: Handling overload
sources.supportRationale: Capacity, bounded queues, load shedding and retry-aware overload reasoning.

sources.title: Amazon Builders’ Library: Timeouts, retries and backoff with jitter
sources.supportRationale: Timeout uncertainty, safe repeated effects, retry amplification, bounded retries and jitter; URL redirects to the author's AWS Builder Center article.
